SASBDB entry SASDMM9  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDMM9/)

RocR (response regulator of Pseudomonas aeruginosa), tetramer, 50 mM Tris-HCl, 250 mM NaCl,
10 mM imidazole, 5 % glycerol, 0.5 mM DTT, pH 7.5, EMBL X33.
Publication: Chen M et al., "Structural Insights into the Regulatory Mechanism of the
Response Regulator RocR from Pseudomonas aeruginosa in Cyclic Di-GMP Signaling",
J Bacteriol 2012, DOI 10.1128/JB.00560-12.
Files:
  experimental_data/SASDMM9.dat    SASBDB media/intensities_files (q in nm^-1)
  SASDMM9_fit1.fit                 SASBDB media/fitting_files (CRYSOL, q in A^-1, 3 columns)
  SASDMM9_fit1_model1.pdb          SASBDB media/pdb_file (REFMAC model, chains A-D, 168 HOH,
                                   4 Mg and one HEPES written as ATOM records; no PDB link)
Two fits: fit1 CRYSOL (header "Chi:1.081" is chi, so chi2 = 1.169 = SASBDB's 1.168561; used)
and a DAMMIF fit without chi2. No file was modified. The paper (Fig. 3A) itself fits the wild-type curve with the R286W
crystal model; no SAXS temperature is given anywhere (25 C assumed).
